source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Αγαπίων ο Ρωμαίος»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3070/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The name the page prints is Αγαπίων, not Αγάπιος, and it is kept as the page spells it; the second Agapius of this same day, `agapius-22-november`, is the other line and the other page. No folder in the corpus answers to Αγαπίων. **He is given `types: ["confessor"]` and not `martyr`**, because the page says he came out of the beasts unharmed and died in peace. No year, no hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
